purpose: Teach: 挙式/原宿/マフィア/マドリード/ハローワーク/フェラーリ/軽井沢/種子

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、姉さんの挙式行ったろ?
lines.en: Did you actually go to your sister's wedding?
lines.style: Tossed out casually, a smirk underneath. Leaning against the challenge. Eyes bright with the knowledge of a gotcha.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、原宿でクレープ食ってたな、桜
lines.en: Yeah, and you were the one eating crepes in Harajuku, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry counter-accusation. Slight head-tilt, almost lazy. The rhythm of someone who's been baited before and knows exactly how to turn it around.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、マフィア映画ばっか観てるな
lines.en: Okay, so you watch mafia movies all day, Riku.
lines.style: Light, thrown-back rhythm. Building on the back-and-forth like she's enjoying this more than she lets on. A small smile at the corner of her mouth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でマドリード習ったろ?桜
lines.en: And you got a lesson on Madrid in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Innocent-sounding on the surface, but the specificity lands like a point scored. Warm underneath, like he's been keeping this detail for exactly this moment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ハローワーク見学行ったろ?
lines.en: So you actually went on a tour of the employment centre?
lines.style: Pressing forward with the same rhythm. Eyebrow raised slightly — genuinely curious now beneath the teasing. Testing to see how far this goes.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、フェラーリのプラモ作ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one making that Ferrari model, Sakura.
lines.style: Softer this time. Not mocking — almost admiring underneath. The words land with a warmth that acknowledges something real he noticed about her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、軽井沢の別荘羨ましがってたな
lines.en: And you were the one jealous of that Karuizawa villa.
lines.style: Quickening slightly, like he's building to something. Still teasing but with an edge of genuine affection now. Watching her reaction carefully.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、理科で植物の種子習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about plant seeds in science class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Closer, more intimate pacing. Slower on the final words. The teasing has softened into something almost vulnerable — like he's saying something else underneath.
